name: @gafiegarcia/scriber
description: Local-first voice transcription powered by your own ElevenLabs Scribe v2 account.

scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run desktop:prepare && ./scripts/verify-ffmpeg-macos.sh arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 && npm run desktop:verify:mac
scripts.desktop:make:mac:local: npm run desktop:prepare && ./scripts/verify-ffmpeg-macos.sh arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run desktop:verify:mac && node scripts/verify-desktop-dmg.js
scripts.desktop:make:mac: npm run desktop:release:check && npm run desktop:prepare && ./scripts/verify-ffmpeg-macos.sh arm64 && SCRIBER_DESKTOP_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run desktop:verify:mac && node scripts/verify-desktop-dmg.js && node scripts/verify-desktop-release.js dist-desktop/mac-arm64/Scriber.app
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node scripts/pack-standalone.js && node scripts/build-cli.js
scripts.test: node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test test/formatters/*.test.ts test/cli/*.test.ts test/core/*.test.ts test/desktop/*.test.ts test/server/*.test.ts
